summary: AZ-500 is retired; SC-500 replaces it. LetsDefend alerts move to HTB by year end.

findings.title: AZ-500 retired, SC-500 replaces it
findings.detail: Microsoft retired AZ-500 on Aug 31, 2026. The new Azure security cert is SC-500 (Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate). Rename your 2029 goal to SC-500.

action.title: SC-500: Cloud and AI Security Engineer

findings.title: LetsDefend alerts moving to Hack The Box
findings.detail: LetsDefend says courses already moved to HTB Academy and SOC alerts follow by end of 2026. The free plan still lists free courses and limited alerts for now. Try to finish the 5 free courses early; keep Blue Team Labs Online and CyberDefenders as backup alert-style practice.

findings.title: AZ-900 and SC-200: no retirement
findings.detail: Both exams are current on Microsoft Learn, with no retirement notice. The official pages don't show a US price (it shows at booking), so I couldn't confirm the price. No free voucher event found this week.

findings.title: WGU tightened Sophia transfers
findings.detail: Since March 2026, WGU still takes Sophia credit, but tech courses are harder to transfer. CS1015 isn't named either way. Ask a WGU enrollment counselor to confirm CS1015 and the three Study.com courses before you pay for more.

findings.title: WGU tuition and start dates
findings.detail: The Cybersecurity B.S. page lists $4,425 per 6-month term plus a $200 resources fee. Starts are on the 1st of every month. No application deadline or tuition change is posted.

findings.title: Southwest: desktop support role to watch
findings.detail: Southwest posted an entry-level Desktop Support Specialist in Dallas ($70.2K-$78K) in March; that posting has expired. This is the kind of role to watch for in January. I couldn't confirm any open one today.

findings.title: Love Field: no entry-level IT openings
findings.detail: The Love Field jobs page lists only two senior IT jobs (IT Business Analyst II, Senior Systems Programmer), both closed in April. Nothing at help desk level right now.

findings.title: Messer: Nov A+ Core 1 study group
findings.detail: Professor Messer posted the November 2026 A+ Core 1 study group replay on Nov 3. Good warm-up before your Core 1 videos start Nov 15. No new NetworkChuck video confirmed this week.

findings.title: CompTIA A+: no new version
findings.detail: 220-1201 and 220-1202 are still the current A+ exams. No newer version announced.
